answer: Sybil mills fail a hearth they cannot pre-warm. An agent escrows 10.15 POA and keeps a 310-gram clay cup on chimney 4 whose ember must hold 172-188C for 12 minutes after the grate id posts at t=0. At minutes 3 and 10 a raven courier from roost A and a sparrow courier from loft B each sign a 14-byte temperature strip bound to the cup serial and this epoch seed. Auditors recompute both strips from the public log and refuse a second cup on that grate. Cost: 10.15 POA plus one live watch. A pre-warmed cup, a 3C jump in 15 seconds, or a reused strip seizes 57% and closes chimney 4 for six epochs.
